creator: Alexander Terp
description: A send with named keys turns its final --enter into a key press (Input::writes), which bypasses the plain-Return fallback added on 2026-11-13 for a shell whose terminal a dead program left in kitty report-all-keys mode. So pane send --key end --enter at such a shell still does not submit. Found in review; predates that fix.
title: pane send --key ... --enter sends its Return as a key press, so it is not submitted at a shell a program left in kitty report-all-keys
